from.place: proof, the Koszul resolution on the regular sequence x_0,x_1

title: Exact graded Koszul resolution for k[x_0,x_1]
statement: For a field k and S=k[x_0,x_1] graded by total degree, using [def-sc-p1-standard], the graded complex 0 \to S(-2) --(x_1,-x_0)\to S(-1) direct sum S(-1) --(x_0,x_1)\to S \to k \to 0 is exact, where S(e) is the shifted graded module [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] (2), k=S/(x_0,x_1) and every displayed map is homogeneous of degree zero.
